hypothesis: A feature-distance screen can catch source-shifted inputs on which the CNN is overconfident. At the same master acceptance rate it should reject more errors than a maximum-score screen.
calibration_split: SHA-256 of reliability-v1 and recorded validation group ID, 40 percent calibration by group
fit: Temperature and thresholds use the master calibration groups only. Feature centroids and pooled diagonal variance use group-averaged master training features only.
promotion: If a combined or distance screen clears guards, freeze it before opening the new field collection. Report coverage, accepted accuracy and incorrect suggestions per upload, with no guard calibration on that collection.
external_deployment_guard: On the registered photos, reduce the error rate among accepted images and retain at least 25 percent of the originally correct predictions. Treat counts as a single-source stress check.
